race.comment: POLAR EYES (9) is desperate to break through. Looked the winner when straightening here last time, only to be nabbed late. Strips rock-hard fit and draws well again. OLIVIA MARIE (8) finished full of running into second here last start over the 1000m. Has kept the legs ticking over with a trial in between and should appreciate the added trip. Big threat. MAKE ME A MATCH (13) is a Tagaloa filly on debut for the Hickmott yard. Has come along nicely in her lead-up work and draws kindly. Worth a market watch. COSMIC SHOWER (6) is knocking on the door and continues to attract market interest. In the mix.
